Title: Info
Text:
ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE
The ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE command sorts (reorders) the records of the current selection of an object field based on the attribute passed in parameter. It's essentially the adaptation of the ORDER BY command for object fields.

Example
There is an example on the next page showing how you can implement a list box from an object field selection. Then sort the selection by clicking on the header. The selection will be ordered according to one or more attributes.

Title: Example
Text: The selection listbox is showing some defined attribute from the Object field, retrieved using the command OB GET.In order to sort the Object field you can either click on the header showing the attribute or the attribute concatenation, or you can select one of the existing attributes in the field by clicking on the "Order by" drop-down list.
